from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates, gaussian_filter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def inpaint(img, mask):
    out=img.copy()
    for _ in range(550):
        avg=(np.roll(out,1,0)+np.roll(out,-1,0)+np.roll(out,1,1)+np.roll(out,-1,1))/4
        out[mask]=avg[mask]
    return out

def masks():
    m=Image.new('L',(256,144));d=ImageDraw.Draw(m)
    d.ellipse((150.8,76.4,154.4,81.8),fill=255)
    d.ellipse((154.5,75.9,159.0,81.4),fill=255)
    d.line([(149.8,83.7),(150.2,86.3),(152.0,88.2),(154.3,88.0),(156.2,86.8),(158.4,85.4),(158.2,83.5),(158.4,85.2),(161.0,86.0)],fill=255,width=3)
    d.line([(162,77.3),(163,78.3),(161,81),(160.5,83),(160,86),(160.6,88.5),(162.2,91.0),(162.6,93)],fill=255,width=3)
    a=np.array(m)>0
    m=Image.new('L',(256,144));d=ImageDraw.Draw(m)
    d.line([(214.5,60.0),(216.5,60),(219,59.6),(222,59.7),(223.6,60.5),(224.5,62),(224.6,64)],fill=255,width=2)
    b=np.array(m)>0
    return a,b

# Coordinates of the two views of the same ball. The reflection has opposite handedness.
VIEWS=[(158.0,84.4,9.5,0.,False),(219.15,63.95,6.45,np.deg2rad(-145),True)]
ELEV=np.deg2rad(12)

def basis(phi,flip):
    right=np.array([np.cos(phi),0,-np.sin(phi)])*(-1 if flip else 1)
    up=np.array([-np.sin(ELEV)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(ELEV),-np.sin(ELEV)*np.cos(phi)])
    toward=np.array([np.cos(ELEV)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(ELEV),np.cos(ELEV)*np.cos(phi)])
    return right,up,toward

def main():
    original=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'),dtype=float)
    mm=masks();bases=[inpaint(original,m) for m in mm]
    ratios=[np.clip((original-b)/np.maximum(b,20),-0.92,1.0) for b in bases]
    # Keep extracted surface marks strictly on their spheres.
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:144,:256]
    for j,(cx,cy,r,ph,fl) in enumerate(VIEWS):
        q=((xx-cx)/r)**2+((yy-cy)/r)**2
        ratios[j][q>1]=0
    ss=4
    frames=[np.uint8(original)]
    for frame in range(1,20):
        theta=np.deg2rad(165)*frame/19
        out=original.copy()
        for view_id,(cx,cy,r,phi,flip) in enumerate(VIEWS):
            x0,x1=int(cx-r-3),int(cx+r+4)
            y0,y1=int(cy-r-3),int(cy+r+4)
            ys=y0+(np.arange((y1-y0)*ss)+.5)/ss-.5
            xs=x0+(np.arange((x1-x0)*ss)+.5)/ss-.5
            y,x=np.meshgrid(ys,xs,indexing='ij')
            a=(x-cx)/r; b=(cy-y)/r; q=a*a+b*b
            z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-q))
            right,up,normal=basis(phi,flip)
            n=a[...,None]*right+b[...,None]*up+z[...,None]*normal
            # Inverse of the clockwise rotation about the platform's vertical axis.
            source=n.copy()
            source[...,0]=np.cos(theta)*n[...,0]+np.sin(theta)*n[...,2]
            source[...,2]=-np.sin(theta)*n[...,0]+np.cos(theta)*n[...,2]
            total=np.zeros(n.shape); weights=np.zeros(q.shape)
            for k,(scx,scy,sr,sphi,sflip) in enumerate(VIEWS):
                rr,uu,nn=basis(sphi,sflip)
                tx=source@rr; ty=source@uu; tz=source@nn
                sx=scx+sr*tx; sy=scy-sr*ty
                val=np.stack([map_coordinates(ratios[k][...,c],[sy,sx],order=1,mode='constant',cval=0,prefilter=False) for c in range(3)],-1)
                # Prefer the least oblique observation; each carries only surface paint and stitching.
                weight=np.clip(tz/.28,0,1)**2
                total+=val*weight[...,None];weights+=weight
            paint=total/np.maximum(weights[...,None],1e-8)
            paint[q>=1]=0
            paint=gaussian_filter(paint,sigma=(.9,.9,0))
            paint=paint.reshape(y1-y0,ss,x1-x0,ss,3).mean(axis=(1,3))
            base=bases[view_id][y0:y1,x0:x1]
            out[y0:y1,x0:x1]=np.clip(base*(1+paint),0,255)
        frames.append(np.uint8(np.clip(out+.5,0,255)))
    frames=np.stack(frames)
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)

if __name__=='__main__': main()

    deltas = []

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates, gaussian_filter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def inpaint(img, mask):
    out=img.copy()
    for _ in range(550):
        avg=(np.roll(out,1,0)+np.roll(out,-1,0)+np.roll(out,1,1)+np.roll(out,-1,1))/4
        out[mask]=avg[mask]
    return out

def masks():
    m=Image.new('L',(256,144));d=ImageDraw.Draw(m)
    d.ellipse((150.8,76.4,154.4,81.8),fill=255)
    d.ellipse((154.5,75.9,159.0,81.4),fill=255)
    d.line([(149.8,83.7),(150.2,86.3),(152.0,88.2),(154.3,88.0),(156.2,86.8),(158.4,85.4),(158.2,83.5),(158.4,85.2),(161.0,86.0)],fill=255,width=3)
    d.line([(162,77.3),(163,78.3),(161,81),(160.5,83),(160,86),(160.6,88.5),(162.2,91.0),(162.6,93)],fill=255,width=3)
    a=np.array(m)>0
    m=Image.new('L',(256,144));d=ImageDraw.Draw(m)
    d.line([(214.5,60.0),(216.5,60),(219,59.6),(222,59.7),(223.6,60.5),(224.5,62),(224.6,64)],fill=255,width=2)
    b=np.array(m)>0
    return a,b

# Coordinates of the two views of the same ball. The reflection has opposite handedness.
VIEWS=[(158.0,84.4,9.5,0.,False),(219.15,63.95,6.45,np.deg2rad(-145),True)]
ELEV=np.deg2rad(12)

def basis(phi,flip):
    right=np.array([np.cos(phi),0,-np.sin(phi)])*(-1 if flip else 1)
    up=np.array([-np.sin(ELEV)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(ELEV),-np.sin(ELEV)*np.cos(phi)])
    toward=np.array([np.cos(ELEV)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(ELEV),np.cos(ELEV)*np.cos(phi)])
    return right,up,toward

def main():
    original=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'),dtype=float)
    mm=masks();bases=[inpaint(original,m) for m in mm]
    ratios=[np.clip((original-b)/np.maximum(b,20),-0.92,1.0) for b in bases]
    # Keep extracted surface marks strictly on their spheres.
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:144,:256]
    for j,(cx,cy,r,ph,fl) in enumerate(VIEWS):
        q=((xx-cx)/r)**2+((yy-cy)/r)**2
        ratios[j][q>1]=0
    ss=4
    frames=[np.uint8(original)]
    for frame in range(1,20):
        theta=np.deg2rad(165)*frame/19
        out=original.copy()
        for view_id,(cx,cy,r,phi,flip) in enumerate(VIEWS):
            x0,x1=int(cx-r-3),int(cx+r+4)
            y0,y1=int(cy-r-3),int(cy+r+4)
            ys=y0+(np.arange((y1-y0)*ss)+.5)/ss-.5
            xs=x0+(np.arange((x1-x0)*ss)+.5)/ss-.5
            y,x=np.meshgrid(ys,xs,indexing='ij')
            a=(x-cx)/r; b=(cy-y)/r; q=a*a+b*b
            z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-q))
            right,up,normal=basis(phi,flip)
            n=a[...,None]*right+b[...,None]*up+z[...,None]*normal
            # Inverse of the clockwise rotation about the platform's vertical axis.
            source=n.copy()
            source[...,0]=np.cos(theta)*n[...,0]+np.sin(theta)*n[...,2]
            source[...,2]=-np.sin(theta)*n[...,0]+np.cos(theta)*n[...,2]
            total=np.zeros(n.shape); weights=np.zeros(q.shape)
            for k,(scx,scy,sr,sphi,sflip) in enumerate(VIEWS):
                rr,uu,nn=basis(sphi,sflip)
                tx=source@rr; ty=source@uu; tz=source@nn
                sx=scx+sr*tx; sy=scy-sr*ty
                val=np.stack([map_coordinates(ratios[k][...,c],[sy,sx],order=1,mode='constant',cval=0,prefilter=False) for c in range(3)],-1)
                # Prefer the least oblique observation; each carries only surface paint and stitching.
                weight=np.clip(tz/.28,0,1)**2
                total+=val*weight[...,None];weights+=weight
            paint=total/np.maximum(weights[...,None],1e-8)
            paint[q>=1]=0
            paint=gaussian_filter(paint,sigma=(.9,.9,0))
            paint=paint.reshape(y1-y0,ss,x1-x0,ss,3).mean(axis=(1,3))
            base=bases[view_id][y0:y1,x0:x1]
            out[y0:y1,x0:x1]=np.clip(base*(1+paint),0,255)
        frames.append(np.uint8(np.clip(out+.5,0,255)))
    frames=np.stack(frames)
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)

if __name__=='__main__': main()
